title: Landmark CNNs & Transfer Learning
description: Trace CNN evolution from AlexNet and VGG to ResNet's skip connections. Master transfer learning on pre-trained backbones.

slides.title: The Milestones of Computer Vision 🏆
slides.content:
# The Architecture Hall of Fame

The annual ImageNet Large Scale Visual Recognition Challenge (ILSVRC) drove rapid architectural evolution:

| Architecture | Year | Notable Breakthrough | ImageNet Top-5 Error |
| :--- | :--- | :--- | :--- |
| **AlexNet** (Krizhevsky et al.) | 2012 | Dual GPU training, ReLU activations, Dropout | 15.3% (Ignited deep learning revolution) |
| **VGG-16** (Simonyan & Zisserman)| 2014 | Homogeneous stacks of small $3 \times 3$ conv filters | 7.3% |
| **GoogLeNet** (Szegedy et al.) | 2014 | Inception multi-scale parallel filter modules | 6.7% |
| **ResNet-50** (He et al.) | 2015 | Residual Skip Connections (152 layers deep!) | **3.57%** (Surpassed human visual baseline: ~5%) |

slides.title: The ResNet Revolution: Skip Connections ⚡
slides.content:
# Solving the Degradation Problem

Prior to 2015, stacking more than 20 layers caused training error to *increase* due to vanishing gradients during backpropagation.

Kaiming He introduced **Residual Connections (Skip Connections)**:

$$\mathcal{H}(\mathbf{x}) = \mathcal{F}(\mathbf{x}) + \mathbf{x}$$

Instead of forcing convolutional layers $\mathcal{F}(\mathbf{x})$ to learn the complete mapping, they only learn the **residual difference** $\mathcal{F}(\mathbf{x}) = \mathcal{H}(\mathbf{x}) - \mathbf{x}$.

Because the identity mapping $\mathbf{x}$ has a derivative of $+1.0$, error gradients flow backward through hundreds of layers without decaying toward zero!

quizData.question: What primary problem do ResNet skip connections (identity shortcuts) resolve?

options.text: They eliminate the need for GPU hardware during training
They allow gradients to propagate directly through hundreds of layers, preventing vanishing gradients
They convert convolutional layers into decision trees
They reduce color images to binary black-and-white

quizData.explanation: Because the derivative of the identity shortcut is 1.0, gradients flow freely backward across deep residual blocks without diminishing.

slides.title: Transfer Learning with PyTorch & Torchvision 🐍
slides.content: Fine-tuning a pre-trained ResNet backbone for custom classification:
slides.codeSnippet:
import torch.nn as nn
import torchvision.models as models

# Load pre-trained ResNet-18 weights
model = models.resnet18(weights=models.ResNet18_Weights.DEFAULT)

# Freeze feature extraction backbone
for param in model.parameters():
    param.requires_grad = False

# Replace final classification head with custom classes (e.g. 5 classes)
num_ftrs = model.fc.in_features
model.fc = nn.Linear(num_ftrs, 5)

print('Replaced final classification head with 5 custom outputs!')

slides.title: AI Pro Tip: Standing on the Shoulders of Giants 🚀
slides.content:
## Why Never Train Vision Backbones From Scratch
Training a model like ResNet-50 from scratch requires weeks on clusters of GPUs and millions of labeled images. In 99% of enterprise tasks, downloading pre-trained ImageNet weights and fine-tuning only the final layers yields higher accuracy in under an hour!
